svg.title: Numerical refinement and prescribed-input sensitivity
svg.desc: Left: second-order finite differences reconstruct the known velocity from the analytic streamfunction on 16–128 interval grids. Right: changing imposed flow by±20 percent changes volume/flow inversely. Volume/flow is a bulk turnover scale, not a particle residence-time distribution or a clinical risk measure.
